book.name: HECHOS
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ KAM BꞌANEL (Hechos) Unqꞌa veeꞌ ibꞌan unqꞌa apóstol

content: Ni tal u Luꞌ tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌnil uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u Tiixh te u Cornelio
As tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa apóstol tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uvaꞌ atik tu u Judea tiꞌ uvaꞌ antu veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ jit tiaal Israel kat niman veꞌt viyol u Tiixheꞌ.
As tul oon veꞌt u Luꞌeꞌ tu u Jerusalén, as xeꞌt veꞌt unqꞌa imooleꞌ stiꞌ, uvaꞌ tiaal Israel.
As ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ tukꞌ yaa: —¿Kam kat bꞌex abꞌanoꞌk tikabꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ jit tiaal Israel? As kat txꞌaꞌn axh tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,— tiꞌk chajnaj.
As ech tal veꞌt u Luꞌ ileꞌ tiꞌ talat isuuchil kam chit uvaꞌ kat ibꞌana:

—Tul atik in tu u tenam uvaꞌ Jope as tul nik unnach Tiixh, as kat ikꞌuch tibꞌ sve echeꞌ umaj vatzikꞌ. As kat vil umaꞌl u vaaꞌ echeꞌ nimla ixbꞌuꞌj uvaꞌ kat kuꞌ chꞌuꞌl tu almikaꞌ. As kajvaꞌl ixoobꞌ kat vila tul kat kuꞌ chꞌuꞌl. As ech tul sunvatz kat uli.

As tul kat unsaji kam uvaꞌ atik stuul, as kat vil kaꞌl unqꞌa txoo uveꞌ kajvaꞌl toj, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa txoo uveꞌ xoꞌvebꞌal chittuꞌ, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa txoo uveꞌ nijuxu tibꞌ vatz txꞌavaꞌ, tukꞌ kaꞌt unqꞌa tzꞌikin uveꞌ nixichꞌan tu almikaꞌ.
As vabꞌi veꞌt umaꞌl u tuul viꞌ uvaꞌ ech tal ileꞌ sve: «Txakpen, Luꞌ. As yatzꞌ unqꞌa txooeꞌ. As echbꞌu,» tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.
As ech val veꞌt ileꞌ: «Pap, tan yeꞌ atixoj ok umaj kam tuntziꞌ uvaꞌ kam kuxh echbꞌubꞌalil. As mitaꞌn uveꞌ yeꞌ la uch techbꞌuleꞌ,» chꞌin kat vala.
As yolon veꞌt kuꞌ tzan sve tu almikaꞌ unpajte. As ech tal ileꞌ: «Kam uveꞌ kat tal u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la echbꞌuli, as yeꞌ la uch aalataꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la echbꞌuli,» tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.
As oxpajul chit ibꞌana. As eqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ u nimla ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ tu almikaꞌ.
As tul maꞌtik teqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ u ixbꞌuꞌjeꞌ, as bꞌex oonoj veꞌt oxvaꞌl unqꞌa naj tu u kabꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ atikkat in, tan chajelik chajnaj taꞌn umaꞌl u naj uvaꞌ tu u Cesarea.
As maꞌtik talat u Tiixhla Espíritu sve uvaꞌ yeꞌ la kaꞌkabꞌin vaama tiꞌ unbꞌen tiꞌ chajnaj. As kat bꞌen vaajit unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ sviꞌ. As kat ok veꞌt oꞌ tu vikabꞌal u najeꞌ.

As kat tal veꞌt naj sqe uvaꞌ maꞌtik tilat naj umaꞌl u ángel uvaꞌ txaklik veꞌt tikabꞌal naj. As ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ te naj: «As chaj bꞌen kaꞌvoꞌj naj tu u tenam uvaꞌ Jope tiꞌ bꞌen teqꞌol tzan u Simón uvaꞌ Luꞌ ni talpeꞌ,
tan aꞌ u Simón la alon isuuchil see tiꞌ uvaꞌ la sotz apaav tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ at takabꞌal,» tiꞌk u ángel tal te naj.
As tul nik val veꞌt viyol u Tiixheꞌ, as kat ul veꞌt u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan sqiꞌ bꞌaxa.

As kat ul veꞌt sunkꞌuꞌl uvaꞌ kat tal kan u Kubꞌaal Jesús, tul ech tal Aak ileꞌ: «Echeꞌ u Xhuneꞌ tan xeꞌ kuxh u aꞌeꞌ ni taqꞌkat bꞌen unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. Pet ech koj ex, tan tuknal okoj u Tiixhla Espíritu tu vetaanxelaleꞌ,» tiꞌk Aak.

¿As kam veꞌt vijleꞌm qꞌi uvaꞌ la unmaj veꞌt ivatz u Tiixheꞌ? Tan u txꞌajaꞌmeꞌ uvaꞌ kat taqꞌ u Tiixheꞌ sqe, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ niman tetz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo, as an chiteꞌ kat taqꞌ veꞌt Aak te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ unpajte,— tiꞌk u Luꞌeꞌ.

As tul tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u yoleꞌ uveꞌ tal u Luꞌeꞌ, as bꞌaꞌn uveꞌ kat ibꞌan ste. As toksa veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ. Ech tal veꞌt ileꞌ: —¡As jit kuxh oꞌ bꞌa la uch kukꞌaxat qibꞌ tiꞌ u kupaaveꞌ vatz u Tiixheꞌ! ¡Pet antu veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ jit tiaal Israel la sotz ipaav tiꞌ taqꞌax itiichajil kꞌatz u Tiixheꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ.
Ninimal viyol u Tiixh tu u Antioquía

As tul maꞌtik iyatzꞌpu u Esteban, as ooj veꞌt unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús tu unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ nik itilul veꞌteꞌ. At uxhchil kat oojik bꞌen tu u Fenicia tukꞌ tu u Chipre tukꞌ tu u Antioquía. As yeꞌxh katil nik talkat unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Jesús. Pet te kuxh veꞌt unqꞌa imooleꞌ uvaꞌ tiaal Israel.

Pet ech koj kaꞌt unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús uvaꞌ nik itiluleꞌ, tan tzaa veꞌt chajnaj tu u Chipre tukꞌ tu u Cirene. As tul oon veꞌt tu u Antioquía, as tal veꞌt chajnaj u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel.
As atik veꞌt vibꞌaꞌnil u Kubꞌaal Jesús tiꞌ unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As nimal uxhchil kat ijalpu veꞌt vitxumbꞌaleꞌ, tan kat inima veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús uveꞌ atik tu u Jerusalén tiꞌ uvaꞌ nik tuch tu u Antioquía, as ichaj veꞌt bꞌen chajnaj u Bernabé tiꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌen tu u Antioquía.

As tul oon veꞌt u Bernabé, as vaꞌlik chit ichiibꞌ veꞌteꞌ, tan til veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ nimal vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ atik tiꞌ unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús. As ibꞌeya veꞌt u Bernabé te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil uvaꞌ tukꞌ chit taanxelal la inima viyol u Kubꞌaal Jesús.

As nimal chit unqꞌa tenameꞌ ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesús, tan chꞌiꞌumal chit itxumbꞌal u Bernabé, tan aqꞌel itxumbꞌal taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ ibꞌanataꞌ kam uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ ste. As kꞌujleꞌl chit ikꞌul tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ.
As xamtik veꞌt stuul, as bꞌen veꞌt u Bernabé tu u Tarso tiꞌ bꞌen ichukat u Saulo. As tul ilej veꞌt u Bernabé u Saulo, as teqꞌo veꞌt u Bernabé u Saulo stiꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌen tu u Antioquía.

As umaꞌl yaabꞌ atin veꞌt xoꞌl unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús tu u Antioquía. As nimal unqꞌa tenameꞌ nik ichus veꞌteꞌ. As bꞌaxa chit oksal veꞌt ibꞌii unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús uvaꞌ «cristiano» chꞌelel, taꞌn unqꞌa aa Antioquía.
As tu unqꞌa qꞌiieꞌ as bꞌen veꞌt kaꞌl unqꞌa qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ tu u Jerusalén. As oon veꞌt tu u Antioquía.

As txakebꞌ veꞌt umaꞌl naj uvaꞌ Agabo ibꞌii xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tiꞌ talat umaꞌl u yol taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ibꞌan umaꞌl u mamaꞌla vaꞌy vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As aꞌs ibꞌana, tul atik ok u Claudio ijlenaalil.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Agabo, as iyolbꞌe veꞌt chajnaj uvaꞌ la taqꞌ bꞌen umaꞌl u lochbꞌal te unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tu u Judea, jankꞌoj uvaꞌ la uch taqꞌataꞌ.
As ech ibꞌaneꞌ, tan ichaj veꞌt bꞌen unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Bernabé tukꞌ u Saulo tiꞌ iqꞌajsal u lochbꞌaleꞌ te unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ atik tu u Judea.
